assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key areas use the repository provisional rough polygons (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false); they are for intake, design discussion and self-check only, not official redlines, approvals or precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: All areas and spatial conclusions must be recalculated when official polygons are released; no precise-area or statutory claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Six global AI innovation ecosystem cases (Kendall Square, Shenzhen, Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Helsinki, Austin) are used only as mechanism comparisons; company names, investment amounts, output values or policy arrangements are not cited as facts or commitments.
assumptions.impact: Cases do not constitute spatial control basis or implementation commitments.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, landmarks, event systems and operation mechanisms are conceptual proposals for professional teams to deepen; they are not approved operations, government decisions or investment commitments.
assumptions.impact: No claim of approval or guaranteed implementation is made.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints in geometry/buildings.geojson express conceptual prototype blocks, not existing buildings, ownership or demolition/renovation/new-build conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Building area metrics support space-supply discussion only; statutory scale needs official survey and control plans.
